crossRefs.note: The slain will fall among you, and you will know that I am Yahweh.
Yet, behold, there will be left a remnant in it that will be carried out, both sons and daughters. Behold, they will…
They will comfort you, when you see their way and their doings; then you will know that I have not done all that I have…
They have denied Yahweh, and said, “It is not he. Evil will won’t come on us. We won’t see sword or famine.
Those who escape the sword will return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah few in number. All the remnant…
He has confirmed his words, which he spoke against us, and against our judges who judged us, by bringing on us a great…
But my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, didn’t they overtake your fathers? “Then they…

translations.web: They will know that I am Yahweh. I have not said in vain that I would do this evil to them.” ’
translations.bsb: And they will know that I am the LORD; I did not declare in vain that I would bring this calamity upon them.
translations.kjv: And they shall know that I am the LORD, and that I have not said in vain that I would do this evil
translations.asv: And they shall know that I am Jehovah: I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them.
